dossier_meta.catalog_title: Long directed cycles in diregular digraphs
dossier_meta.subject: Graph Theory » Directed Graphs
dossier_meta.statement_text: Conjecture Every strong oriented graph in which each vertex has indegree and outdegree at least $ d $ contains a directed cycle of length at least $ 2d+1 $ .
dossier_meta.context_text: The disjoint union of two regular tournaments on $ 2d+1 $ vertices shows that this would be best possible. If the oriented graph has order at most $ 4d+1 $ , Jackson conjecture the existence of a longer cycle, namely a Hamilton cycle
dossier_meta.references_text: - *[J] B. Jackson. Long paths and cycles in oriented graphs. J. Graph Theory 5 (1981), 145--157.
